subject: infra.connect
name: SADC Regional Infrastructure Development Master Plan
milestone: Adopted August 2012, horizon to 2027
position_start: In force since 2012, carrying the ICT sector plan for a Digital SADC
position_end: Unchanged, with under two years to its horizon; no revision or successor held

subject: infra.connect

milestone: Two bidders shortlisted, 2025-11-27
position_start: No host selection process on record

position_end: A technical submission on orbital positions filed with the ITU and the radiocommunication sector met to secure the slot, with a working group created to assess financing mechanisms and payment model; the project is stated to be at an early stage and no cost, launch date or operator is held (2026-08)
note: The account is the meeting chair's; no ITU filing reference is held.

subject: infra.capacity

sources: 2025-09-24 Unveiling Seacom 2.0 - ​ ​A new digital renaissance and subsea network to power the Indian Ocean Basin's digital and AI future

subject: infra.cybersec

milestone: Approved at Ezulwini, 2026-07-30
position_start: In drafting by working groups led by Botswana and Zimbabwe
position_end: Finalised and approved, with supervision extended to cloud hosts and payment processors

subject: infra.cybersec
name: SADC Regional CIRT framework
status: In development, drafted 2018 with nothing on record since
milestone: Draft framework circulated to the SADC Expert Group on PKI and CIRT, Ebene, 13 September 2018
position_start: A draft framework of September 2018, unpublished, with no regional incident-response capability operating
position_end: Unchanged; the 2018 draft is still the newest record held
note: Four member states had operational national CIRTs at the 2018 workshop, against a December 2019 deployment deadline with no follow-up on record

subject: dpi.exchange
name: One-stop border posts and digitised border systems
milestone: Made a chairship priority at the 46th summit, 2026-08-17
position_end: A chairship priority tying one-stop border posts to the corridor trip monitoring system that integrates transport, immigration and customs data, to online permitting and operator accreditation, to one member's electronic visa and travel authorisation, and to a proposed regional tourism visa, with progress to be measured in border-crossing times reduced rather than agreements signed
note: the priority and the measure of progress are the incoming chair's; no baseline crossing time, target or timetable is published

subject: dpi.exchange
name: SADC Agricultural Information Management System
milestone: Botswana readiness assessment, Gaborone, June 2026
position_end: Member-state readiness under assessment with the FAO and the EU; no platform, membership or timetable held

subject: dpi.id
name: SADC cross-border digital-ID and eKYC framework
milestone: Framework unveiled with Co-Develop and FinMark Trust, August 2025
position_start: A South Africa-Lesotho verification pilot, no regional framework
position_end: Federated framework announced for all 16 member states; no build, budget or launch date on record in the year since
sources: 2025-08-26 SADC regional DPI initiative supports KYC, digital ID interoperability across 16 countries

subject: dpi.pay

subject: dpi.pay
name: SADC-RTGS

name: Settlement currencies in the SADC-RTGS

position_end: Two, rand and kwanza; pula and metical named next, four more weighing onboarding by end-2027

subject: gov.regional
name: CRASA (Communications Regulators Association of Southern Africa)
milestone: Legal and policy committee met 10 to 12 August 2026 and the human-resources committee from 18 August
position_end: Convened its members at the G5 summit with MACRA and adopted the Lilongwe Declaration on Collaborative Regulation (2026-04); no work programme, annual report or harmonised guideline held; its legal and policy committee held a first meeting at Windhoek from 10 to 12 August with artificial-intelligence governance, data governance and protection, digital public infrastructure and regulatory harmonisation on the agenda, and its human-resources development committee opened the 2026/27 cycle on 18 August on capacity building, equity and parity in the regional communications workforce
note: The association's own output remains unheld; the Declaration's text is unpublished

subject: gov.regional
name: IDEA programme (Inclusive Digitalization in Eastern and Southern Africa)
milestone: First annual forum closed with a 2026-2027 action plan, 2026-07-29
position_start: US$2.48bn approved in June 2024, phase 1 Angola, DR Congo and Malawi; no forum and no regional action plan
position_end: Phase I is Zambia, DR Congo, Malawi and Angola, with Eswatini, Tanzania and Madagascar preparing Phase II; a Strategic Action Plan and Digital Action Matrix for 2026-2027 agreed

subject: gov.regional

position_start: No preparatory meeting on record

note: The position travels next to the African preparatory meeting APM27-3, convened at Tunis from 7 to 11 September 2026, ahead of WRC-27 at Shanghai.

subject: gov.regional

position_start: Baseline not held

note: a chairpersonship statement of priorities; no work programme, budget or digital-security instrument is published with it

note: a workshop and a self-assessment exercise; no roadmap text, adoption route or timetable is published, and the stated obstacles are fragmented frameworks, capacity gaps and uneven policy maturity
